articles.summary: Entocycle, the UK’s leading insect technology company, announced today a collaboration with EnviroFlight, the largest producer of insect-based ingredients for animal and plant nutrition in North America, to develop and trial the Entosight® Neo, Entocycle’s black soldier fly (BSF) breeding technology
articles.title: Entocycle and EnviroFlight partner to develop black soldier fly breeding technology

articles.summary: The rebrand is the first time since its founding in 2014 that the company has updated its logo and visual identity.
articles.title: Insect technology company Entocycle unveils new visual identity to realise global ambitions

articles.summary: Entocycle awarded £100k grant to standardise Entoremediation: an insect-powered solution tackling PFAS, sewage sludge, and wastewater screening waste.
articles.title: Entocycle Secures £100,000 Water Discovery Challenge Grant to Pioneer Insect-Powered Wastewater Treatment

articles.summary: Entocycle today announced raising $2.6 million to finance further expansion plans in Europe and beyond. In parallel, a new R&D insect farm developed by the insect technology company has officially opened in Yorkshire.
articles.title: Entocycle raise a further $2.6m as new insect rearing facility opens in Yorkshire

articles.summary: Entocycle, a pioneering technology company in insect farming, is proud to announce the success of its recent collaboration with EnviroFlight, the largest producer of insect-based ingredients for animal and plant nutrition in North America.
articles.title: Trials of Entocycle’s optical dosing solution at EnviroFlight a success

articles.summary: Insect technology company Entocycle and the University of Leeds, a Russell Group university, announce a partnership to advance research into the use of insects in circular on-farm feed systems.
articles.title: Entocycle and University of Leeds enter innovation partnership
